svg.title: stonelotus (Constantin-Iulian), Tinkerer class: Founder @ EndSpec, Builder, DevOps Engineer, Software Engineer
svg.desc: I build products end to end, and at EndSpec we fix, harden and scale AI-built software. A torchlit dungeon gate with a cyan wireframe tracing its arch, the name stonelotus carved in gold, the class plate CLASS: TINKERER, roles cycling between Founder @ EndSpec, Builder, DevOps Engineer and Software Engineer, and an adventurer holding a glowing lantern.

g.text: I build products end to end, and at EndSpec
we fix, harden and scale AI-built software.
